ucs.title: [LLM] Mustang Panda / Stately Taurus PlugX DLL side-loading via relocated trusted-vendor binary
ucs.description: Hunts the signature Mustang Panda (RedDelta / Earth Preta / Bronze President / Twill Typhoon) delivery chain: a legitimately-signed third-party vendor EXE (Avast wsc_proxy, McAfee, Adobe, VLC, etc.) is dropped into a user-writable directory alongside a malicious co-located DLL, which it side-loads to run PlugX/Korplug. The tell is a trusted host binary running from — and loading a DLL from — ProgramData/AppData/Temp/Public rather than its real install path.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("wsc_proxy.exe","aro.exe","mcods.exe","mcvsshld.exe","avastsvc.exe","adobelm.exe","acrobat.exe","vlc.exe","onedrive.exe","hex.exe","potplayer.exe","esetonline.exe","msmpeng.exe") AND (Processes.process_path IN ("*\\Users\\*","*\\ProgramData\\*","*\\AppData\\*","*\\Temp\\*","*\\Public\\*","*\\Downloads\\*")) AND NOT (Processes.process_path IN ("*\\Program Files*","*\\Windows\\*")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process_path Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process Processes.process_hash
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
| sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let WritablePaths = dynamic([@"\users\", @"\programdata\", @"\appdata\", @"\public\", @"\temp\", @"\downloads\", @"\perflogs\"]);
let SideloadHosts = dynamic(["wsc_proxy.exe","aro.exe","mcods.exe","mcvsshld.exe","avastsvc.exe","adobelm.exe","acrobat.exe","vlc.exe","onedrive.exe","hex.exe","potplayer.exe","esetonline.exe","avgcc.exe","msmpeng.exe"]);
DeviceImageLoadEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(14d)
| where FileName endswith ".dll"
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (SideloadHosts)            // signed vendor host binaries Mustang Panda repeatedly abuses
| where FolderPath has_any (WritablePaths)                       // malicious DLL co-located in a user-writable dir
| where InitiatingProcessFolderPath has_any (WritablePaths)      // ...and the trusted EXE was relocated there too = the side-load tell
| where InitiatingProcessFolderPath !has @"\windows\" and InitiatingProcessFolderPath !has @"\program files"
| extend SameFolder = tolower(FolderPath) startswith tolower(InitiatingProcessFolderPath)
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountName, HostBinary = InitiatingProcessFileName, HostPath = InitiatingProcessFolderPath, SideloadedDll = FileName, DllPath = FolderPath, SameFolder, SHA256, InitiatingProcessSHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let SideloadHosts = dynamic(["wsc_proxy.exe","aro.exe","mcods.exe","mcvsshld.exe","avastsvc.exe","adobelm.exe","acrobat.exe","vlc.exe","onedrive.exe","hex.exe","potplayer.exe","esetonline.exe","msmpeng.exe"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend ProcName = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| where ProcName in (SideloadHosts)                                  // trusted vendor binary relocated to a user-writable dir (side-load precursor)
| where NewProcessName has_any (@"\Users\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\AppData\", @"\Temp\", @"\Public\", @"\Downloads\")
| where NewProcessName !has @"\Program Files" and NewProcessName !has @"\Windows\"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName, ProcName
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Mustang Panda DLL Side-Loading via Relocated Trusted-Vendor Binary
id: 7f3c2b1a-9d4e-4c8a-bb21-3e6f0a1c2d44
status: experimental
description: Detects a signed third-party vendor binary loading a DLL from a user-writable directory it was relocated into - the PlugX side-load pattern used by Mustang Panda / Earth Preta.
logsource:
    category: image_load
    product: windows
detection:
    selection_host:
        Image|endswith:
            - '\wsc_proxy.exe'
            - '\aro.exe'
            - '\mcods.exe'
            - '\mcvsshld.exe'
            - '\adobelm.exe'
            - '\vlc.exe'
            - '\hex.exe'
            - '\potplayer.exe'
            - '\onedrive.exe'
    selection_path:
        ImageLoaded|contains:
            - '\Users\'
            - '\ProgramData\'
            - '\AppData\'
            - '\Temp\'
            - '\Public\'
    filter_system:
        ImageLoaded|contains:
            - '\Windows\System32\'
            - '\Program Files'
    condition: selection_host and selection_path and not filter_system
falsepositives:
    - Portable/standalone copies of these apps run from user directories
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:7 @Image:(*\wsc_proxy.exe OR *\WSC_PROXY.EXE OR *\aro.exe OR *\Aro.exe OR *\mcods.exe OR *\adobelm.exe OR *\vlc.exe OR *\VLC.exe OR *\hex.exe OR *\potplayer.exe OR *\onedrive.exe OR *\OneDrive.exe) @ImageLoaded:(*\Users\* OR *\users\* OR *\ProgramData\* OR *\programdata\* OR *\AppData\* OR *\appdata\* OR *\Temp\* OR *\temp\* OR *\Public\* OR *\public\*) -@ImageLoaded:(*\Windows\System32\* OR *\windows\system32\* OR *\Program Files* OR *\program files*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\(wsc_proxy|aro|mcods|mcvsshld|avastsvc|adobelm|acrobat|vlc|onedrive|hex|potplayer|esetonline|msmpeng)\.exe$/i
| regex("\\\\(Users|ProgramData|AppData|Temp|Public|Downloads)\\\\", field=ImageFileName)
| NOT regex("\\\\(Program Files|Windows)\\\\", field=ImageFileName)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ImageFileName, CommandLine, SHA256HashData], function=count(as=execs))
ucs.rationale: DLL side-loading of PlugX/Korplug through legitimately-signed but relocated vendor executables is the single most consistent piece of Mustang Panda tradecraft across every cluster name (RedDelta, Earth Preta, Bronze President, Stately Taurus, Twill Typhoon) since 2017. The named host-binary list (wsc_proxy/Avast, mcods/McAfee, Adobe, VLC, PotPlayer, OneDrive) is drawn directly from their repeatedl
_sigma_issues: no MITRE ATT&CK tag (expected at least one `attack.t####`)

ucs.title: [LLM] Earth Preta USB-worm propagation (HIUPAN/MISTCLOAK) — PE + decoy LNK co-drop to removable drive
ucs.description: Detects Earth Preta's removable-media worm component (HIUPAN / MISTCLOAK staging PUBLOAD/PlugX) replicating to USB: a non-shell process writes a payload executable/DLL plus a disguised .lnk to the root of a removable drive within the same burst, the hallmark of the worm hiding the real drive contents behind a launcher shortcut. This is the propagation behavior that distinguishes Earth Preta from other Chinese PlugX operators.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats `summariesonly` values(Filesystem.file_name) as file_names count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.action=created AND (Filesystem.file_path IN ("D:\\*","E:\\*","F:\\*","G:\\*","H:\\*","I:\\*","J:\\*")) AND (Filesystem.file_name IN ("*.exe","*.dll","*.lnk")) by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.file_path Filesystem.process_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
| eval joined=mvjoin(file_names,",")
| eval has_lnk=if(match(joined,"(?i)\.lnk"),1,0), has_pe=if(match(joined,"(?i)\.(exe|dll)"),1,0)
| where has_lnk=1 AND has_pe=1
| where NOT (process_name IN ("explorer.exe","msiexec.exe","setup.exe","searchprotocolhost.exe"))
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
| sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(14d)
| where FileName endswith ".exe" or FileName endswith ".dll" or FileName endswith ".lnk"
| where FolderPath matches regex @"(?i)^[d-z]:\\"                       // removable / secondary drive root
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("explorer.exe","msiexec.exe","setup.exe","searchprotocolhost.exe","searchindexer.exe")
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| extend Ext = tolower(tostring(extract(@"(\.[A-Za-z0-9]+)$", 1, FileName)))
| summarize Writes = count(), Exts = make_set(Ext), Files = make_set(FileName, 25), FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp)
        by DeviceId, DeviceName, DriveRoot = tostring(split(FolderPath, "\\")[0]), InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessFolderPath
| where Exts has ".lnk" and (Exts has ".exe" or Exts has ".dll")        // worm: payload + disguised launcher on the same removable drive
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
ImFileEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| where EventType == "FileCreated"
| where TargetFileExtension in~ ("exe","dll","lnk")
| where TargetFilePath matches regex @"(?i)^[d-z]:\\"
| where ActingProcessName !endswith "explorer.exe" and ActingProcessName !endswith "msiexec.exe" and ActingProcessName !endswith "setup.exe"
| extend DriveRoot = tostring(split(TargetFilePath, "\\")[0])
| summarize Exts = make_set(tolower(TargetFileExtension)), Files = make_set(TargetFileName, 25), Writes = count(), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
        by DvcHostname, ActingProcessName, DriveRoot
| where Exts has "lnk" and (Exts has "exe" or Exts has "dll")
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Earth Preta USB Worm - PE Plus Decoy LNK Written to Removable Drive Root
id: c41a8e7d-2b56-4f19-9a3c-7d2e10b5f8a3
status: experimental
description: Detects a non-shell process creating an executable/DLL alongside a disguised .lnk at a removable drive root - the HIUPAN/MISTCLOAK propagation pattern used by Mustang Panda / Earth Preta.
logsource:
    category: file_event
    product: windows
detection:
    selection_drive:
        TargetFilename|re: '(?i)^[D-Z]:\\[^\\]+\.(exe|dll|lnk)$'
    filter_shell:
        Image|endswith:
            - '\explorer.exe'
            - '\msiexec.exe'
            - '\setup.exe'
            - '\SearchProtocolHost.exe'
    condition: selection_drive and not filter_shell
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate portable-app installers or backup tools writing to external drives
level: medium
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:11 @TargetFilename:(D\:\* OR E\:\* OR F\:\* OR G\:\* OR H\:\* OR I\:\* OR J\:\*) @TargetFilename:(*.exe OR *.EXE OR *.dll OR *.DLL OR *.lnk OR *.LNK) -@Image:(*\explorer.exe OR *\Explorer.exe OR *\msiexec.exe OR *\setup.exe OR *\SearchProtocolHost.exe)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=FileWritten TargetFileName=/^[d-z]:\\[^\\]+\.(exe|dll|lnk)$/i
| ContextImageFileName!=/\\(explorer|msiexec|setup|SearchProtocolHost|SearchIndexer)\.exe$/i
| regex("\\.(?<Ext>[A-Za-z0-9]+)$", field=TargetFileName)
| DriveRoot := regex_extract("^(?<d>[A-Za-z]:)", field=TargetFileName)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextImageFileName, DriveRoot], function=[count(as=writes), collect([Ext, TargetFileName])])
| writes >= 2
ucs.rationale: Earth Preta (Trend Micro's name for Mustang Panda) is one of the few state actors that still leans heavily on USB-worm self-propagation (HIUPAN/MISTCLOAK staging PUBLOAD and PlugX) to jump air-gapped/segmented networks across SE-Asian government targets. _sigma_issues: no MITRE ATT&CK tag (expected at least one `attack.t####`)
